schedules.description: The current attempt observes the synchronous warm frame.
Warm-frame UI switches visits before start emits again; the retired attempt admits no second frame.
A frame accepted before hide finishes decoding afterward: audit remains, UI is suppressed.
Two deferred frames resolving in arrival order both advance the UI.
A newer synchronous frame publishes before an older decode; the older frame remains audit-only.
Detaching A synchronously selects C, so outer select B is superseded before B starts.
Detaching A synchronously hides, so outer select B is superseded before B starts.
Reversed decode, progress-triggered switch, cleanup-triggered switch, audit retention, and current UI compose in one trace.
Retry keeps the visit-wide arrival order: a late accepted old-attempt frame is audited but cannot roll back the new warm frame.
The adjacent diagnostic consumer intentionally ignores cached bootstrap and records only later live deltas.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: The warm publication synchronously switches visits before start returns.
expected_changed_effects: The old attempt rejects the second start-time frame and B owns the workspace.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: The visit remains current while accepted decodes settle in arrival order.
expected_changed_effects: Current ordered decodes publish to both audit and UI.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: Decode completion order is reversed while event arrival order is unchanged.
expected_changed_effects: The older completion remains in audit but cannot roll visible progress backward.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: The detach hook hides instead of selecting C.
expected_changed_effects: No destination owns a listener after cleanup.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: The newer frame additionally triggers outer navigation whose cleanup selects C.
expected_changed_effects: C supersedes B while the accepted old frame remains audit-only.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: A retry replaces the attempt without replacing the visit, then an old accepted decode settles late.
expected_changed_effects: The previous attempt is canceled, its accepted frame remains audited, and the visit-wide UI order does not roll back.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: The same warm feed is consumed by diagnostics rather than the panel.
expected_changed_effects: Diagnostics preserve their delta-only policy and do not count cached bootstrap.
